# Hair By Melissa

> One-stylist hair salon in Kaukapakapa, North Auckland, New Zealand. Colour, balayage, highlights, keratin smoothing treatments and cuts by Melissa. Clients come from Helensville, Wainui, Waitoki and the wider Rodney district. Open 7 days. Listed on Google as "Hair By Melissa A".

Salon: 12 Magnolia Lane, Kaukapakapa 0875, Auckland, NZ (about 45 minutes north-west of central Auckland, 15 minutes from Helensville via SH16, free parking).
Phone: 0274 799 320. Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–1:30pm, Sat 2–5pm, Sun 9am–5pm. Book online at https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/booking/

## Services and prices (NZD)

- [Balayage](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/balayage/): hand-painted, low-maintenance colour. $230, 3–4 hours.
- [Keratin treatment](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/keratin-treatments/): smoothing treatment that reduces frizz for 3–5 months. $180, 2–3 hours.
- [Full head highlights](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/full-head-highlights/): $180, 2.5–3 hours.
- [Half head highlights](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/half-head-highlights/): foils on the top, crown, parting and face-framing sections. $140, 2–2.5 hours.
- [Permanent tint, all over](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/permanent-tint-all-over/): $140, 1.5–2 hours.
- [Partial foils](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/partial-foils/): $90, 1–1.5 hours.
- [Permanent tint touch-up](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/permanent-tint-touch-up/): regrowth colour. $90, 1–1.5 hours.
- [Women's cut and finish](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/womens-cut-finish/): $50, 45–60 minutes.
- [Blow wave](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/blow-wave/): $50, 45–60 minutes.
- [Toner](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/toner/): $40, 30–45 minutes.
- [UV protection treatment](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/uv-protection-treatments/): $40.
- [All services](https://hairbymelissa.co.nz/services/)
